A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the YBCO plated disc resonator based filter is a viable solution for tunable filters operating at cryogenic temperatures.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of a single resonator is not the best approach in terms of insertion loss and tuning range.
the KTaO/sub3/ disc resonator is a very good candidate for tunable filters in the frequency range of interest.
